answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood every cheap signup inlet before bonds bite. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 50-POA onyx stake for 3 epochs before attestation weight; a second identity inside 24h pays umber-cost 2x, a third 4x, to an on-ledger burn sink. Cost: 50–200 POA locked plus 3-epoch wait. Verification: peers check bond txid and lock height before first attestation. Failure: early unlock or cross-clone reuse slashes 100% and bans the pubkey for 8 epochs.
